feeds.title: Windsurfing UK Magazine
feeds.description: Windsurfing UK aims to bring the best windsurfing content available - from real-world sailors to pros alike. Waves to freestyle, race to freeride, everyday sailors to complete beginners and everything else in between. We focus on the UK's domestic scene and highlighting what it's like to be a windsurfer. Stay tuned for regular updates from the colorful world of UK windsurfing.

feeds.title: The Peconic Puffin
feeds.description: The Peconic Puffin was first published in 1993 as a weekly newspaper, focusing on a group of windsurfers who shared a summer house on the Peconic bays of Long Island. And now is a windsurfing blog focusing on Long Island windsurfing.

feeds.title: SurferToday » Windsurfing
feeds.description: The latest breaking news from the windsurfing world. Top stories from windsurfers and windsurfing competitions. Daily windsurf news updates. The world's leading windsurfing site.

feeds.title: James' Blog
feeds.description: A marine biology professor at Florida Gulf Coast University writes about winsurfing.

feeds.title: Continentseven
feeds.description: Launched in 2000, Continentseven is a vision of three windsurfers to create the seventh continent - a continent without borders, a continent for open-minded and individualistic windsurfing, surfing culture, a continent for all watersport enthusiasts.

feeds.title: US Windsurfing
feeds.description: US Windsurfing is an organization dedicated to making the whole windsurfing experience more positive for windsurfers in the USA. Our mission is to encourage participation and promote excellence and enjoyment in recreational windsurfing and racing in the United States. We provide member services, instruction certification, event management, club development and promotion support.

feeds.title: A Year (Windsurfing) en Provence
feeds.description: I'm a Canadian guy who started this windsurfing blog during our sabbatical year in France. I have since added a decade of fun windsurfing posts from our other adventures including freestyle, wavesailing, the International Windsurfing Tour and now wind foiling.

feeds.title: Roberts Blog
feeds.description: This blog is where Roberts writes about windsurfing experience, news, Surfdays, Competition report, and also a lot of other topics.

feeds.title: 2XS Blog
feeds.description: 2XS Blog features write-ups and articles on windsurfing demos, tips, guides, gear and equipment reviews, events, club news, and more. Since 1989 2XS has been selling performance equipment. We specialise in Windsurfing, Kitesurfing and SUP plus all the accessories, wetsuits and secondhand gear that goes with it.

feeds.title: Windsurf Magazine
feeds.description: How to Windsurf, Technique, Tips, News, Equipment Reviews, Videos and the Best Features Online

feeds.title: Poole Windsurfing
feeds.description: Windsurfing news, reviews, advice & discussions. Windsurfing tips on techniques, bargain buys, travel destinations & equipment reviews.

feeds.title: USA 4 Windsurfing Campaign
feeds.description: Steve Bodner USA-4 Formula Windsurfing Campaign- regatta reports and updates from the San Francisco Bay and beyond featuring Steve Bodner.

feeds.title: Phil's Windsurfing Blog
feeds.description: Windsurfing Blogs which everyone must follow by Phil.

feeds.title: Pritchard Windsurfing
feeds.description: Having fun, teaching clinics, ripping waves, selling new and used gear while promoting the great sport we all love!

feeds.title: Big Winds Blog
feeds.description: Read Big Wind's blog to get tips, how-tos, test reviews, guides, and more on windsurfing. Established in 1987, we are one of the largest windsurfing, kiteboarding and stand up paddle product and accessory stores in the United States.

feeds.title: Starboard Windsurf Blog
feeds.description: Starboard was founded in 1994 by Svein Rasmussen. It all came from the vision of bringing innovation, quality and inspiration to the world of wind and water. Together with riders and partners around the world, Starboard and Tiki strive to be the best in the world and for the world.

feeds.title: Toronto Windsurfing Club
feeds.description: The Toronto Windsurfing Club is a not-for-profit association host to just over 550 members, making it the largest windsurfing club in Canada, possibly North America. Managed by volunteers and dedicated to safe, friendly and enjoyable windsurfing for all.

feeds.title: Surf Sup » Windsurfing
feeds.description: Surf Sup is a family of watersports enthusiasts who just love everything watersports, with a legacy going back many many years. The Inflatable stands up paddleboards and watersports lessons we offer are top-notch and this is something we're very proud of. We regularly run paddleboard lessons, windsurfing lessons, wing foil lessons and sup surfing lessons.

feeds.title: The Reef Warriors and Casey's Hit the Lip Blog
feeds.description: The reef Warriors is a group of watermen and women who love waves and rum! Read the Reef Warriors and Casey's Hit the Lip Blog on windsurfing, featuring articles and videos on boards, foiling, gears, and more.

feeds.title: Better World Windsurfing School Blog
feeds.description: Better World Windsurfing School is the only windsurfing school in Central Pennsylvania where you can have fun learning a new sport in Centre County, PA while supporting a worthy cause that you choose!

feeds.title: Oda Johanne
feeds.description: Oda Johanne is a professional windsurfer from Norway. She is a vice world champion from PWA freestyle 2014. In her blog posts, she offers a range of articles, vlogs, and videos covering all aspects of windsurfing, her travels, and other information about windsurfing.

feeds.title: Phil Soltysiak
feeds.description: Phil Soltysiak was introduced to windsurfing in 1995 and since has been windsurfing and travelling. Phil in his blog has been offering guided tips, his surfing adventure, best spots to surf, championship & nationals, travels, and more.

feeds.title: Planet Windsurf Blog
feeds.description: Search our stories and get inspired by our passionate team of writers, windsurf travel specialists, local experts and ambassadors. Planet Windsurf Holidays is the UK's largest and oldest ATOL & TTA bonded Windsurf Holiday Travel Specialist offering expert advice on Windsurf Resorts and Windsurfing Holidays.

feeds.title: Average Joe Windsurfing Blog
feeds.description: I'm Joe. I am just an average joe who does windsurf and tries to get as much time on the water as possible. I started this blog as a windsurf journal and then just got carried away. You can read articles on board & reviews, health & safety, and learn about all the technicalities of windsurfing.

feeds.title: Tarifa Spin Out Blog
feeds.description: The Spin Out Spirit was founded in 1988 at the Valdevaqueros beach. We offer high quality equipment, suitable for all levels and sailing conditions. As well as courses for all levels. Our blog offers articles on windsurf, windsurf-foil and wingsutf-foil.

feeds.title: Sarah Jackson Windsurfing
feeds.description: I'm Sarah. I'm one of the very few privileged athletes that get to travel around the World as a part of their sport! Here you can read the stories of my adventures - from the highs to the lows, I try to cover everything within 'Sarah's Stories'. I am a 23-year-old Professional Windsurfer from the North-West of England. Since graduating, I have been working in the windsurfing industry in social media and marketing.

feeds.title: WindSurfingMag Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Kevin Millington. It's great to have you here on my website! It is all about water sports. Whether you are a professional or amateur surfer, my aim is to provide useful information about water sports and ultimately help you be the best. With the quality information on my website, you can improve your skills and practice in a healthy way.

feeds.title: North Beach Windsurfing Blog
feeds.description: Learn about all things windsurfing, winging, foiling, and windsurf foiling on North Beach Windsurfing Blog. North Beach Windsurfing has been providing the St. Pete Beach, FL, area with the exhilaration of windsurfing adventures since 1999. Owner, Britt Viehman, began his love of windsurfing while competing on the windsurfing team at Eckerd College and has coached several high-level windsurfing competitors.

feeds.title: Maui Glory Days Blog
feeds.description: Jonathan Weston is a photographer and author of windsurfing and other books. His Maui Glory Days blog is where he writes articles about his windsurfing experience and adventure.

feeds.title: PP Jutras Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is PP Jutras. I'm a strength and conditioning coach. I am windsurfing addicted and many other water sports. Over the past 14 years, I've helped hundreds of people empower their health and live better lives. I offer online coaching, free training, tips, information, and more.
